key.name: monitor-brightness
key.description: JSON object mapping monitor connectors to brightness levels

key.name: monitor-methods
key.description: JSON object mapping monitor connectors to preferred methods (auto, overlay, ddc)

key.name: monitor-ddc-bus
key.description: JSON object mapping monitor connectors to i2c bus numbers for DDC

key.name: preferred-method
key.description: Default method to use for brightness control (auto, overlay, ddc)

key.name: show-percentage
key.description: Whether to display the brightness percentage next to the icon

key.name: target-monitor
key.description: Which monitors to control (all-external, specific connector)

key.name: sync-all-monitors
key.description: When true, all external monitors share the same brightness level

key.name: detected-monitors
key.description: JSON array of detected external monitor connectors
